homeward_stone.name: Homeward Stone
homeward_stone.desc: Warm to the touch, like a hearthstone. Right-click it; it recharges in thirty minutes. To choose where it takes you, ask a city's priest to bind you (Keeper Maelin, Dawnpriest Amaru, Tidepriest Nalini), or type /bind beside the bindstone.

draught_of_homecoming.name: Draught of Homecoming
draught_of_homecoming.desc: One use. Brewed by alchemists, sold by provisioners.
